item.text: When general_log= is given, the wheel writes to that logger and builds no other.
item.title: general_log

item.text: The wheel builds its own Logger with LoggerBuilder even when the caller passed session_log=.
item.title: session_log

item.text: If session_log= is passed, sc-agent-py skips default logger construction for the session log entirely.
item.title: Injected only

item.text: Document session_log= in the wheel docstring.
item.title: Logger docs

item.text: Alongside the injected general_log, the wheel creates a python logging.Logger that mirrors every record.
item.title: Mirror logger

cases.rationale: Not the wheel or injected loggers.

item.text: When the caller injects general_log= but not session_log=, the wheel builds the default session logger only.
item.title: Other log default

cases.rationale: A different log is not a second logger for the injected log.

item.text: When no logger is passed, the wheel builds the default general logger.
